verdict.rationale: Warp's own marketing says Warp Agent handles payroll and asks the user when a decision is theirs. That implies a first-party payroll-run capability, but the evidence does not describe the specific review-preview-submit flow. Missing for 10: documented review of hours and earnings, a preview of payroll totals, an explicit submit step in a single flow, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits. It asks when a decision is yours, and records every action it takes.
